a09-rash-1: AI-Generated, High, 41; AI-Generated, Low, 9; Human, Low, 32; Human, High, 61

AI-Generated High (41 words): An intense altered state can make everything feel final, cosmic, and urgent, and it might feel like you have to act right now. But more likely the urgency is just part of the state, and acting on it isn't safe.
AI-Generated Low (9 words): Put yourself on a 24–72 hour action lock.
Human Low (32 words): Until you have slept and eaten, maybe don't drive, travel, break up, make up, quit your job, confess everything, confront or accuse that list of people you've been meaning to...
a10-rash-2:
AI-Generated High (106 words): Write it down, get some sleep, and go back over it with one grounded person once your head is clear.
Treat trip content first as experience-content, rather than fact-content. Because you saw it, it might feel like you have to act on it, and because it felt cosmic, obeying it might seem wise. But more likely you had an experience, and it can wait until the state has passed.
No revelation makes murder, assault, coercion, sexual boundary-crossing, reckless driving, or self-harm safe tonight. Anything requiring violated consent or harm belongs in the notebook until you can review it with a clear head.
a11-euph-1:
AI-Generated High (80 words): The action lock matters especially when the state feels blissful: I am God. I am chosen. Everybody must hear this tonight. I finally understand everything. Bliss is not proof of safety, and it often makes grounding less welcome.
Two questions while glowing:
Have I slept? Sleep comes before mission.
Has this happened before, and how did it end? A recurring pattern with lost sleep, racing thoughts, pressured speech, or everyone saying you are not yourself needs grounded support before action.

a15-touch-1:
AI-Generated High (64 words): Self-touch is different from somebody else touching you. Compassion does not mean grabbing, hugging, restraining, stroking, or crowding. Ask first: "Would touch help, or would you rather have space?" Good support may be silent presence from six feet away.
When the person says stop, freezes, pulls away, or seems unsure, stop. Touch must remain nonsexual, consensual, and unrelated to the helper's needs.

a17-demons-2:
AI-Generated High (65 words): I don't have to settle whether these things are objectively real or internal formations because the response is mostly the same.
Hatred, fear, shame, pride, and rage make hooks. Love removes hooks.
The common mistake is fighting the terrifying thing with the energy it already consumes. Panic fights panic, hatred fights hatred, pride fights pride, and suddenly a small war is running inside consciousness.
a19-demons-4:
AI-Generated High (68 words): It might look passive, but this is how you become unhookable. A demon can fight your hatred, feed on your fear, argue with your pride or seduce your grandiosity, but there's nothing in love for it to grab.
When somebody is medically, physically, or psychologically too overwhelmed to reach love, stabilize first. Don't teach nondual demonology to somebody who needs the lights down and a doctor.
a20-abuse-1:
AI-Generated High (126 words): Psychedelics and intense practices can bring up true trauma, symbolic material, distorted fragments, fears, fantasies, archetypes, past-life narratives, and mixtures of all of them. Don't dismiss what arises. Don't treat the certainty you feel in that state as evidence either.
Don't confront tonight
When you see or remember abuse, betrayal, murder, past lives, hidden crimes, or cosmic plots, write it down and get safe. Don't confront anybody while intoxicated or destabilized. Return to it after sleep with a trauma-informed therapist, integration specialist, or grounded person you trust.
The experience may matter deeply. It could be true psychologically, or symbolically, or literally, or only partly true, or false in the form it first took. You don't have to decide tonight.
a21-spirit-1: Human Medium (9 words): The triage above is meant to make trips useful.
a22-spirit-2:
AI-Generated High (64 words): Bypassing reaches for an ultimate view--"we are all One," "I don't exist," "this is all karma," "everything is Love"--while ignoring the person shaking in the corner.
Practice says love is here, so we make the room safer, call for help when needed, stop pretending, and hold the experience without becoming it.
That is tripsitting, shadow work, and the path becoming practical.
a23-storm-1:
AI-Generated High (114 words): No "another ceremony will fix this" reflex.
Don't take more psychedelics, cannabis or ketamine, do intense breathwork, fast, push kundalini, deprive yourself of sleep, meditate or stretch to extremes, or schedule "another ceremony to fix it" while destabilized. Deep practice can wait until the floor is back.
Then ask what actually happened. What was medical or environmental? What was emotional? What was old trauma? What was fantasy? What was useful? What changed behavior? What needs therapy, an apology, rest, or plain practical action?
It can feel like the more cosmic the story sounds, the bigger the insight. But the fruit of an insight is whether suffering goes down and love gets more available.
